_provenance.definition: anything human: roles, relations, feelings, crafts, body and acts, in the plan owner's words. A word belongs when a person would hear it as something human; the bucket is a mnemonic flavour, not a taxonomy.

sourceDictionary.role: the reference dictionary: every shipped word is present in it, checked with grep -x, one process per word

classificationSources.name: WordNet 3.0 (Princeton)
classificationSources.role: primary sense field for words it covers: person, body, act, feeling, cognition, communication, group, relation, motive and the social/emotional/competitive/creative verbs are PEOPLE; animal, plant, object, substance, phenomenon, food, weather, location, time, quantity and shape stay with NATURE

classificationSources.name: Webster's Unabridged 1913 glosses
classificationSources.role: definition text for words WordNet does not cover; a definitional frame naming a person or an act admits the word

rules.shape: lowercase a-z, 4 to 9 letters, one word, no spaces and no hyphens
rules.membership: every shipped word is byte-identical to a line of /usr/share/dict/words, checked with grep -x
rules.duplicates: no word appears twice in this theme; every word already owned by the NATURE or SPIRIT buckets, shipped or harvested, is excluded so the three themes stay disjoint
rules.target: at least 400 words for every letter a-z
rules.bannedVocabulary: words carrying the v2 vocabulary ban's substrings are excluded from this file and are not written anywhere in it
